crossRefs.note: For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.
In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.
The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of fools gush out folly.
For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”

crossRefs.note: Therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”

crossRefs.note: Therefore I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his works; for that is his portion: for…
For who knows what is good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow? For who can…
For he doesn’t know that which will be; for who can tell him how it will be?
Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city, and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”
Whereas you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears…

translations.web: A fool also multiplies words. Man doesn’t know what will be; and that which will be after him, who can tell him?
translations.bsb: Yet the fool multiplies words. No one knows what is coming, and who can tell him what will come after him?
translations.kjv: A fool also is full of words: a man cannot tell what shall be; and what shall be after him, who can tell
translations.asv: A fool also multiplieth words: yet man knoweth not what shall be; and that which shall be after him, who can tell him?
